# scripts/mutation-pr.sh over a stub gremlins: each result of the script and each input that it refuses.
# The script never passes a run that tested nothing. It reads "no candidate" from an all-skipped report only after the report proves its paths.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:git] skip
env HOME=$WORK/home
env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
env GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
chmod 755 fake/gremlins
chmod 755 fake/timeout
chmod 755 bare/git
chmod 755 bare/dirname
env SAVED_PATH=$PATH
env PATH=$WORK/fake:$PATH

# The base commit holds the module and the script at the top folder of the repository, b.go, which no branch changes,
# and c.go, which only the branches twoedits and renamed change. Each branch changes one thing.
exec git init -q -b main repo
cp a.go repo/a.go
cp b.go repo/b.go
cp c.go repo/c.go
cp gomod repo/go.mod
script mutation-pr.sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh
script mutation-exec.sh repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh
chmod 755 repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh
exec git -C repo add a.go b.go c.go go.mod scripts
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b docs
cp notes.txt repo/notes.txt
exec git -C repo add notes.txt
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m docs
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b nocand main
cp nocand.go repo/a.go
exec git -C repo add a.go
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m nocand
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b cand main
cp cand.go repo/a.go
exec git -C repo add a.go
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m cand

# MUTATION_TIMEOUT accepts only a positive whole number of seconds. The fake gremlins fails the run if it starts.
env MUTATION_TIMEOUT=0
! exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: MUTATION_TIMEOUT is "0"\. Set it to a positive whole number of seconds, such as 1200\.$'
! stdout 'the fake gremlins ran'
env MUTATION_TIMEOUT=ten
! exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: MUTATION_TIMEOUT is "ten"\.'
env MUTATION_TIMEOUT=-5
! exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: MUTATION_TIMEOUT is "-5"\.'
env MUTATION_TIMEOUT=

# A diff with no Go source change is not applicable, and it needs no tool: the path holds git and dirname only.
exec git -C repo checkout -q docs
env PATH=$WORK/bare
exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: not applicable: no Go source change against main$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=0 printed=0$'
! stdout '(?s)^mutation-pr: end .*^mutation-pr: '
env PATH=$WORK/fake:$SAVED_PATH

# Changed lines whose operators sit only in a comment, a string or a pointer type: gremlins finds mutants in b.go only,
# all skipped. The report names files under the module root, so the run passes as "no candidate".
# This path prints no counts line: a counts line with applied=0 is a failed run for the reader of the job log.
exec git -C repo checkout -q nocand
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/allskipped.json
exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
! stdout '^mutation-pr: applied='
stdout '^mutation-pr: no candidate: no changed line of a\.go holds an operator that gremlins mutates; the report marks all 2 mutant\(s\) of the changed folders skipped$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=0 printed=0$'
! stdout '(?s)^mutation-pr: end .*^mutation-pr: '

# A changed line with an operator and a report with no mutant for it fails: an empty report, a report of other paths,
# a report with no mutant, or mutants on changed lines that are all not covered.
# A run that stops before its counts line is a tool error and prints no end marker. A run that fails after it prints the end marker.
exec git -C repo checkout -q cand
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/empty.json
! exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: gremlins wrote no report: it found no mutant in \.$'
! stdout 'in the module'
! stdout 'no candidate'
! stdout '^mutation-pr: end '
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/otherpath.json
! exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: the gremlins report names files that are not under .*: internal/a\.go internal/b\.go\. Its paths do not match the diff\.$'
! stdout 'no candidate'
! stdout '^mutation-pr: end '
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/nomutant.json
! exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: the gremlins report holds no mutant$'
! stdout 'no candidate'
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=0 killed=0 lived=0 timed_out=0$'
stdout '(?s)^mutation-pr: applied=0 .*^mutation-pr: the gremlins report holds no mutant$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=0 printed=0$'
! stdout '(?s)^mutation-pr: end .*^mutation-pr: '
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/notcovered.json
! exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=0 killed=0 lived=0 timed_out=0$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: no mutant was applied\.'
! stdout 'no candidate'
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=0 printed=0$'
! stdout '(?s)^mutation-pr: end .*^mutation-pr: '

# A report that does not match the diff fails, even when its files exist: a skipped mutant on a changed line,
# or a mutant off the changed lines that gremlins did not skip.
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/skippedchanged.json
! exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: the gremlins report does not match the diff against main: .* at a\.go:3$'
! stdout 'no candidate'
! stdout '^mutation-pr: end '
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/keptunchanged.json
! exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: the gremlins report does not match the diff against main: .* at b\.go:3$'
! stdout 'no candidate'
! stdout '^mutation-pr: end '

# The changed lines are the lines that gremlins reads from its own diff, which has context lines. For each hunk,
# gremlins starts at the first line after the leading context and counts one line for each added line.
# Edits on lines 3 and 7 of c.go form one hunk, so gremlins keeps lines 3 and 4 and skips line 7. That report matches.
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b twoedits main
cp c-twoedits.go repo/c.go
exec git -C repo add c.go
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m twoedits
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/twoedits.json
exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=2 killed=2 lived=0 timed_out=0$'
! stdout 'does not match'

# gremlins finds renames in its diff. A file that is renamed and edited has only its edited line changed. That report matches.
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b renamed main
exec git -C repo mv c.go d.go
cp d-renamed.go repo/d.go
exec git -C repo add d.go
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m renamed
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/renamed.json
exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=1 killed=1 lived=0 timed_out=0$'
! stdout 'does not match'
# diff.noprefix removes the "b/" of the diff. gremlins still reads a file at the top folder by its name, and so does the script.
exec git -C repo config diff.noprefix true
exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=1 killed=1 lived=0 timed_out=0$'
! stdout 'does not match'
exec git -C repo config --unset diff.noprefix

# With diff.noprefix, gremlins reads a file in a subfolder without its first folder, and skips its mutants. So the script
# gives the git of gremlins a config that keeps the prefixes, after the config that the environment already holds.
# The script starts gremlins on the folder sub, so its diff is relative to sub.
# This fake gremlins reads its own git diff: it keeps the mutant of e.go only when the diff names "b/e.go".
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b subfolder main
mkdir repo/sub
cp cand.go repo/sub/e.go
exec git -C repo add sub/e.go
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m subfolder
exec git -C repo config diff.noprefix true
env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=e2e.kept
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=yes
env GREMLINS_REPORT=owndiff
exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=1 killed=1 lived=0 timed_out=0$'
! stdout 'does not match'
exec git -C repo config --unset diff.noprefix
exec git -C repo config diff.mnemonicPrefix true
exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=1 killed=1 lived=0 timed_out=0$'
! stdout 'does not match'
env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0
exec git -C repo config --unset diff.mnemonicPrefix

# More than 50 lived mutants on changed lines: 50 finding lines and 50 marker lines; the summary line and the end marker hold the full count.
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b many main
cp many.go repo/a.go
exec git -C repo add a.go
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m many
env GREMLINS_REPORT=many
! exec /bin/sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=51 killed=0 lived=51 timed_out=0$'
stdout -count=50 '^finding: a\.go:[0-9]+: a mutant lived: ARITHMETIC_BASE$'
stdout '^finding: a\.go:51: '
! stdout '^finding: a\.go:52: '
stdout '^mutation-pr: 51 mutant\(s\) lived, 50 finding line\(s\) printed\. Kill each one with a test\.$'
stdout -count=50 '^mutation-pr: lived a\.go:[0-9]+ ARITHMETIC_BASE$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: lived a\.go:51 '
! stdout '^mutation-pr: lived a\.go:52 '
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=51 printed=50$'
! stdout '(?s)^mutation-pr: end .*^mutation-pr: '

# The paths of gremlins and git match only at the top folder of the repository, in the module root. Each other place fails before gremlins starts.
env GREMLINS_REPORT=
exec git init -q -b main nested
mkdir nested/sub
cp a.go nested/sub/a.go
cp gomod nested/sub/go.mod
script mutation-pr.sh nested/sub/scripts/mutation-pr.sh
exec git -C nested add sub
exec git -C nested -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C nested checkout -q -b cand
cp cand.go nested/sub/a.go
exec git -C nested add sub
exec git -C nested -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m cand
! exec /bin/sh nested/sub/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: .*/sub is not the top folder of its git repository$'
! stdout 'the fake gremlins ran'

exec git init -q -b main nomod
cp a.go nomod/a.go
script mutation-pr.sh nomod/scripts/mutation-pr.sh
exec git -C nomod add a.go scripts
exec git -C nomod -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C nomod checkout -q -b cand
cp cand.go nomod/a.go
exec git -C nomod add a.go
exec git -C nomod -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m cand
! exec /bin/sh nomod/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: .*/nomod has no go\.mod, so it is not the module root$'
! stdout 'the fake gremlins ran'

# GOFLAGS splits on spaces and has no quoting, so a module root with a space in its path cannot name the recording script.
exec git init -q -b main 'spaced repo'
cp a.go 'spaced repo/a.go'
cp gomod 'spaced repo/go.mod'
script mutation-pr.sh 'spaced repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh'
script mutation-exec.sh 'spaced repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh'
chmod 755 'spaced repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh'
exec git -C 'spaced repo' add a.go go.mod scripts
exec git -C 'spaced repo' -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C 'spaced repo' checkout -q -b cand
cp cand.go 'spaced repo/a.go'
exec git -C 'spaced repo' add a.go
exec git -C 'spaced repo' -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m cand
! exec /bin/sh 'spaced repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh' main
stdout '^mutation-pr: .*/spaced repo has a space in its path, and GOFLAGS cannot name a script there$'
! stdout 'the fake gremlins ran'

var c4 = 4 + 1

// Lines 5 and 6 hold no operator.

package a

var c3 = 3 - 1
var c4 = 4 + 1

// Lines 5 and 6 hold no operator.
var c7 = 7 + 1

// Lines 8 to 10 hold no operator.
// They give the hunk its trailing context.
-- notes.txt --
notes
-- nocand.go --

-- cand.go --
package a

-- fake/gremlins --
#!/bin/sh
[ -n "${GREMLINS_REPORT:-}" ] || { echo "the fake gremlins ran"; exit 99; }
if [ "$GREMLINS_REPORT" = many ]; then
	{
		printf '{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":['
		i=2
		while [ "$i" -le 52 ]; do
			[ "$i" -eq 2 ] || printf ','
			printf '{"line":%d,"column":9,"type":"ARITHMETIC_BASE","status":"LIVED"}' "$i"
			printf 'a.go\t%d\t9\t8\t0\t\n' "$i" >>"$MUTATION_EXIT_LOG"
			i=$((i + 1))
		done
		printf ']}]}'
	} > "$5"
	exit 0
fi
if [ "$GREMLINS_REPORT" = owndiff ]; then
	[ "$(git config --get e2e.kept)" = yes ] || { echo "the fake gremlins lost the git config of the environment"; exit 98; }
	state=SKIPPED
	if git diff --merge-base "$3" | grep -q '^+++ b/e\.go$'; then state=KILLED; fi
	printf '{"files":[{"file_name":"e.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"%s"}]}]}' "$state" > "$5"
	exit 0
fi
cp "$GREMLINS_REPORT" "$5"
-- fake/timeout --
#!/bin/sh
shift 3
exec "$@"
-- bare/git --
#!/bin/sh
PATH=$SAVED_PATH
export PATH
exec git "$@"
-- bare/dirname --
#!/bin/sh
PATH=$SAVED_PATH
export PATH
exec dirname "$@"
-- empty.json --
-- allskipped.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"b.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"SKIPPED"},{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_BOUNDARY","status":"SKIPPED"}]}]}
-- otherpath.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"internal/a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"SKIPPED"}]},{"file_name":"internal/b.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"SKIPPED"}]}]}
-- nomutant.json --
{"files":[]}
-- notcovered.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"NOT COVERED"},{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_BOUNDARY","status":"NOT COVERED"}]},{"file_name":"b.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"SKIPPED"}]}]}
-- skippedchanged.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"SKIPPED"}]},{"file_name":"b.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"SKIPPED"}]}]}
-- twoedits.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"b.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"SKIPPED"}]},{"file_name":"c.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"ARITHMETIC_BASE","status":"KILLED"},{"line":4,"type":"ARITHMETIC_BASE","status":"KILLED"},{"line":7,"type":"ARITHMETIC_BASE","status":"SKIPPED"}]}]}
-- renamed.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"b.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"SKIPPED"}]},{"file_name":"d.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"ARITHMETIC_BASE","status":"KILLED"},{"line":4,"type":"ARITHMETIC_BASE","status":"SKIPPED"},{"line":7,"type":"ARITHMETIC_BASE","status":"SKIPPED"}]}]}
-- keptunchanged.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]},{"file_name":"b.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
